words.enDefinition: The branch of mechanics that studies forces and moments on bodies in equilibrium.

examples.en: Engineering statics gave our class a way to account for every force acting on the model.
examples.zh: 「工程静力学」让我们学会逐一分析作用在模型上的力。

examples.en: Our first engineering statics assignment asked us to explain why the tabletop frame stayed at rest.
examples.zh: 第一份「工程静力学」作业要求我们解释桌面框架模型为何保持静止。

words.enDefinition: An idealized body whose points remain fixed distances apart under load.

examples.en: We treated the small plate as a rigid body when drawing its forces on the board.
examples.zh: 在黑板上画作用于小板的力时，我们把小板视为「刚体」。

examples.en: The rigid body in the drawing could rotate even though its shape remained unchanged throughout the example.
examples.zh: 图中的「刚体」可以转动，在整个例题中形状保持不变。

collocations: model an object as a rigid body

words.enDefinition: An idealization representing a body as a point and ignoring its size and shape.

examples.en: The joint was small enough that our tutor chose a particle model for its force balance.
examples.zh: 这个节点很小，辅导老师用「质点模型」分析它的力平衡。

examples.en: We used a particle model for the suspended mass and drew every force through one point.
examples.zh: 我们用「质点模型」表示悬挂的重物，把所有力都画成经过同一点。

collocations: apply the particle model to a joint

words.enDefinition: A vector representing the magnitude and direction of a force.

examples.en: I drew the force vector pointing downward from the marked spot in the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 我在课堂草图中从标记位置画出一个向下的「力向量」。

examples.en: We added a second force vector after noticing that the object also touched the wall.
examples.zh: 我们发现物体还接触了墙面，随即加画了第二个「力向量」。

collocations: find the magnitude of a force vector

words.enDefinition: The location on a body at which a specified force acts.

examples.en: The instructor marked the point of application where the cord pulled on the model plate.
examples.zh: 老师标出细绳拉动模型板的位置，也就是「力的作用点」。

examples.en: We compared two drawings that used the same force but placed its point of application differently.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两幅图，两图中的力相同，但「力的作用点」不同。

words.enDefinition: The straight line through the application point in the direction of the force.

examples.en: The line of action passed through the pivot, so the force had no moment about it.
examples.zh: 这条「力的作用线」穿过支点，因此该力对支点的力矩为零。

examples.en: We extended the line of action of the angled force before measuring the perpendicular distance.
examples.zh: 我们延长了斜向力的「作用线」，再测量垂直距离。

collocations: a perpendicular distance to the line of action

words.enDefinition: The part of a force represented along a specified direction.

examples.en: The horizontal force component was zero because the arrow pointed straight down in the example.
examples.zh: 例题中的箭头竖直向下，因此这个「力的水平分量」为零。

examples.en: We wrote each force component next to the axis it followed on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题上把各个「力的分量」标在其对应的轴旁边。

words.enDefinition: To express a force as components in specified directions.

examples.en: We learned to resolve a force into horizontal and vertical components before writing the two equations.
examples.zh: 我们先学会将「力分解」为水平和竖直分量，再列出两个方程。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to resolve a force along the ramp and perpendicular to its surface.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们沿斜面方向和垂直斜面的方向「分解一个力」。

collocations: resolve a force along the axes
resolve a force in two directions

words.enDefinition: A collection of forces acting on the same body.

examples.en: The force system in the example consisted of two cord tensions and the weight of the block.
examples.zh: 题中的「力系」由两根绳子的拉力和滑块的重力组成。

examples.en: We drew the entire force system before determining which arrows contributed to the moment about the hinge.
examples.zh: 我们画出整个「力系」，再判断哪些力对铰链产生力矩。

words.enDefinition: Forces whose lines of action lie in a single plane.

examples.en: All the arrows represented coplanar forces, so the class placed the coordinate axes in the sketch plane.
examples.zh: 所有箭头都表示「共面力」，因此我们把坐标轴设在草图所在的平面内。

examples.en: We checked whether the forces were coplanar forces by tracing their lines on the plate model.
examples.zh: 我们在薄板模型上描出各力的作用线，判断它们是否为「共面力」。

words.enDefinition: Forces whose lines of action pass through one common point.

examples.en: The extensions of the three arrows met at one point, so they represented concurrent forces.
examples.zh: 三个箭头的延长线交于一点，因此它们表示「汇交力」。

examples.en: The tutor used the concurrent forces at the small ring to review horizontal and vertical equilibrium.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用作用在小圆环上的「汇交力」复习水平和竖直方向的平衡。

words.enDefinition: Forces whose lines of action coincide along the same straight line.

examples.en: The two cords pulled along the same straight line, so we added their collinear forces algebraically.
examples.zh: 两根绳子沿同一直线拉动，因此我们把这两个「共线力」作代数相加。

examples.en: We drew collinear forces pointing in opposite directions at the two ends of the bar.
examples.zh: 我们在杆件两端画出方向相反的两个「共线力」。

words.enDefinition: The vector sum of the forces in a system.

examples.en: We found the resultant force by adding the horizontal components and then the vertical components.
examples.zh: 我们分别将水平分量和竖直分量相加，求出了「合力」。

examples.en: Two equal arrows pointed in opposite directions, leaving zero resultant force on the model plate.
examples.zh: 两个等大的力方向相反，因此模型板所受「合力」为零。

words.enDefinition: The sum of moments from all forces and couples about a chosen point or axis.

examples.en: We added the signed contributions to find the resultant moment of the forces about the marked point.
examples.zh: 我们把各项带符号相加，求出这些力对标记点的「合力矩」。

examples.en: The class found a nonzero resultant moment even though the two applied forces cancelled in the sum.
examples.zh: 虽然两个外加力在求和时抵消，我们得到的「合力矩」仍不为零。

collocations: find the resultant moment about a point

words.enDefinition: The rule that moving a force along its line preserves its external effect on a rigid body.

examples.en: We used the principle of transmissibility to slide the force arrow along its original line on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们根据「力的可传性原理」，沿原作用线移动图中的力箭头。

examples.en: The tutor explained the principle of transmissibility before comparing two drawings of the same rigid object.
examples.zh: 辅导老师先解释「力的可传性原理」，再比较同一刚体的两幅图。

words.enDefinition: The turning effect of a force about a specified point or axis.

examples.en: We found the moment of a force by multiplying its magnitude by the perpendicular distance.
examples.zh: 我们将力的大小乘以垂直距离，求出「力矩」。

examples.en: The moment of a force changed when we moved the reference point farther from its line of action.
examples.zh: 将参考点移到离该力作用线更远的位置后，「力矩」发生了变化。

collocations: calculate the moment of a force
the moment of a force about a point
find the direction of the moment of a force

words.enDefinition: The perpendicular distance from a chosen point to a force's line of action.

examples.en: I marked the moment arm at a right angle to the rope's line in our sketch.
examples.zh: 我在草图中垂直于绳子的作用线画出「力臂」。

examples.en: The same pull produced a larger moment when we gave it a longer moment arm.
examples.zh: 使用更长的「力臂」后，同样大小的拉力产生了更大的力矩。

words.enDefinition: A moment tending to rotate a body clockwise in the stated view.

examples.en: We marked the downward load on the right as producing a clockwise moment about the center.
examples.zh: 我们标注出右侧向下的载荷会对中心产生「顺时针力矩」。

examples.en: The clockwise moment received a negative sign under the convention written at the top of our worksheet.
examples.zh: 按照习题顶部的符号约定，我们给「顺时针力矩」记负号。

collocations: assign a sign to a clockwise moment

words.enDefinition: A moment tending to rotate a body counterclockwise in the stated view.

examples.en: The upward force on the right produced a counterclockwise moment about the center of the sketch.
examples.zh: 右侧向上的力对草图中的中心点产生了「逆时针力矩」。

examples.en: We took the counterclockwise moment as positive and wrote its contribution beside the curved arrow.
examples.zh: 我们把「逆时针力矩」取为正，并在弧形箭头旁写出其大小。

words.enDefinition: The moment measured with respect to a chosen point.

examples.en: We found the moment about a point where the hinge met the tabletop model in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们求了「对点的力矩」，取的是图中铰链与桌面模型的连接点。

examples.en: The instructor used a different reference location to show why a moment about a point can change.
examples.zh: 老师换了一个参考点，说明「对点的力矩」为何会发生变化。

collocations: calculate a moment about a point
find the direction of a moment about a point

words.enDefinition: The signed component of a force moment along a specified axis.

examples.en: The worksheet asked for the moment about an axis drawn through the center of the circular model.
examples.zh: 习题要求计算「对轴的力矩」，这根轴穿过圆形模型的中心。

examples.en: We found the moment about an axis by projecting the moment vector onto that axis.
examples.zh: 我们将力矩向量投影到指定轴上，求出「对该轴的力矩」。

collocations: calculate a moment about an axis
resolve a moment about an axis
find a moment about an axis

words.enDefinition: The rule that concurrent forces and their resultant have the same total moment about a point.

examples.en: We applied Varignon's theorem to calculate separate moments for the horizontal and vertical components of the force.
examples.zh: 我们用「瓦里农定理」分别计算该力的水平和竖直分量产生的力矩。

examples.en: The tutor used Varignon's theorem to show that resolving the force left its total moment unchanged.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「瓦里农定理」说明，分解力之后各分量的力矩之和不变。

collocations: use Varignon's theorem to sum moments

words.enDefinition: Two equal, opposite forces acting along distinct parallel lines.

examples.en: The equal arrows formed a force couple because they pointed oppositely along two different parallel lines.
examples.zh: 这两个等大的力方向相反，作用线平行且不重合，因此构成一个「力偶」。

examples.en: Our diagram showed a force couple that tended to turn the plate while applying zero net force.
examples.zh: 图中的「力偶」使板有转动趋势，但合力为零。

collocations: replace a force couple by its moment
a force couple with zero resultant

words.enDefinition: The moment produced by a force couple, independent of the choice of reference point.

examples.en: The couple moment stayed the same when we recalculated it about the other corner of the plate.
examples.zh: 换到板的另一个角重新计算后，「力偶矩」保持不变。

examples.en: We showed the couple moment with a curved arrow beside the two equal and opposite forces.
examples.zh: 我们在两个等大反向的力旁画了一个弧形箭头来表示「力偶矩」。

collocations: represent a couple moment with a curved arrow

words.enDefinition: A vector that can be translated without changing what it represents.

examples.en: The tutor moved the couple moment to another corner because it could be represented as a free vector.
examples.zh: 力偶矩可以用「自由向量」表示，因此辅导老师将它移到另一个角。

examples.en: We still drew the free vector with the original magnitude and direction after moving it.
examples.zh: 移动「自由向量」后，我们画出的向量仍保持原有大小和方向。

collocations: represent a couple moment as a free vector

words.enDefinition: A force system matching another's net force and moment about a common point on a rigid body.

examples.en: We compared the two diagrams and found that each represented an equivalent force system for the rigid plate.
examples.zh: 我们比较两幅图，发现它们为同一刚性板表示了一对「等效力系」。

examples.en: The equivalent force system had three arrows instead of four and produced the same net moment and force.
examples.zh: 「等效力系」只画了三个力，比原力系少一个，合力和合力矩均相同。

collocations: replace loads with an equivalent force system

words.enDefinition: A representation of a force system by a resultant force and a couple moment at a chosen point.

examples.en: We replaced the scattered loads with a force-couple system drawn at the center of the plate.
examples.zh: 我们用画在薄板中心的「力与力偶系统」替代分散作用的各个载荷。

examples.en: The force-couple system showed one straight arrow and one curved arrow at the chosen point.
examples.zh: 「力与力偶系统」在所选点上画出一个直箭头和一个弧形箭头。

collocations: reduce loads to a force-couple system
find a force-couple system at a point

words.enDefinition: A sketch of an isolated body showing the external forces and moments acting on it.

examples.en: I drew the free-body diagram of the block before writing any of the equilibrium equations.
examples.zh: 我先画滑块的「受力图」，再列出各个平衡方程。

examples.en: The tutor added the surface reaction to our free-body diagram after noticing an arrow was missing.
examples.zh: 辅导老师发现漏画了一个箭头，便在我们的「受力图」上补出接触面的反力。

words.enDefinition: To separate an object conceptually so its external forces and moments can be shown.

examples.en: We had to isolate a body from its surroundings before deciding which forces to draw.
examples.zh: 我们先「隔离物体」，再确定需要画出哪些力。

examples.en: The first question asked us to isolate a body and replace its supports with reaction arrows.
examples.zh: 第一题要求我们「隔离物体」，用反力箭头代替支座。

collocations: isolate a body from its surroundings
isolate a body in a free-body diagram

words.enDefinition: A force exerted on a selected body by something outside it.

examples.en: The weight counted as an external force when the plate alone was our chosen system.
examples.zh: 我们只取薄板为研究对象时，重力算作「外力」。

examples.en: We included the cord's pull as an external force on the block in our diagram.
examples.zh: 画图时，我们把绳子的拉力列为作用于滑块的「外力」。

collocations: an external force on the system

words.enDefinition: A force or moment exerted by a support in response to the loads on a body.

examples.en: We drew each support reaction on the beam sketch before adding the known loads to it.
examples.zh: 我们先在梁的草图里画出各个「支座反力」，再加上已知载荷。

examples.en: The support reaction at the roller pointed upward in the answer to the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂例题的答案显示，滚动支座处的「支座反力」指向上方。

collocations: solve for an unknown support reaction

words.enDefinition: Equations expressing zero net force and, for a rigid body, zero net moment.

examples.en: We wrote the equations of equilibrium after agreeing which direction would count as positive in each sum.
examples.zh: 我们统一了各项求和的正方向，然后列出「平衡方程」。

examples.en: The tutor used the equations of equilibrium to check the unknown forces on the practice diagram.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「平衡方程」核对练习图中的各个未知力。

words.enDefinition: The condition of remaining at rest with zero net force and zero net moment.

examples.en: We tested static equilibrium by confirming that the model had zero net force and zero net moment.
examples.zh: 我们确认静止的模型所受合力与合力矩均为零，以检验「静力平衡」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked whether the plate would stay in static equilibrium if we removed the small counterweight.
examples.zh: 习题问，移去小配重后，薄板能否继续保持「静力平衡」。

words.enDefinition: The condition in which the vector sum of forces on a particle is zero.

examples.en: We checked particle equilibrium by adding the three forces that met at the tiny ring.
examples.zh: 我们把汇交在小圆环上的三个力相加，以检查「质点平衡」。

examples.en: The first assignment used particle equilibrium to find the tensions on two strings attached to one point.
examples.zh: 第一份作业用「质点平衡」求连接在同一点上的两根绳子的拉力。

words.enDefinition: The three force component equations and three moment component equations used to check equilibrium of a rigid body in space.

examples.en: We wrote the three-dimensional equilibrium equations before identifying which components vanished in the symmetric classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们先列出「三维平衡方程」，再判断这个有对称性的课堂例题中哪些分量为零。

examples.en: The three-dimensional equilibrium equations included moments about axes that were absent from the planar model.
examples.zh: 「三维平衡方程」还包含平面模型中没有的力矩分量方程。

words.enDefinition: The condition in which moments sum to zero about a common reference point or axis.

examples.en: We wrote a moment balance about the hinge to find the unknown force farther along the model.
examples.zh: 我们以铰链为参考点列出「力矩平衡」方程，求出模型远端的未知力。

examples.en: Our tutor checked moment balance after we corrected the sign of the curved arrow on the sketch.
examples.zh: 我们修正草图中弧形箭头的符号后，辅导老师核对了「力矩平衡」。

words.enDefinition: An ideal support that prevents translation in the plane while allowing rotation.

examples.en: We replaced the pin support with horizontal and vertical arrows in our two-dimensional classroom model.
examples.zh: 在二维课堂模型中，我们用水平和竖直反力箭头代替「铰支座」。

examples.en: The tutor drew a curved arrow to show the rotation allowed by the ideal pin support.
examples.zh: 辅导老师画了一个弧形箭头，表示理想「铰支座」允许的转动。

collocations: replace a pin support with two reaction components

words.enDefinition: An ideal support acting perpendicular to its surface and allowing sliding and rotation in a plane.

examples.en: The reaction at the roller support pointed perpendicular to the smooth surface in the sketch.
examples.zh: 草图中，「滚动支座」处的反力垂直于光滑的支承面。

examples.en: We drew only one reaction arrow for the ideal roller support in our plane equilibrium problem.
examples.zh: 在这道平面平衡题中，我们只给理想「滚动支座」画了一个反力箭头。

collocations: the reaction at a roller support
a roller support on an inclined surface

words.enDefinition: An ideal support restraining both translation and rotation.

examples.en: The worksheet showed a fixed support holding one end of the beam at a constant angle.
examples.zh: 习题画出了一个「固定支座」，使梁的一端保持在固定的角度。

examples.en: We included a moment at the fixed support as well as the two forces in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中，我们在「固定支座」处除了画两个力，还画出了一个力矩。

collocations: a moment at a fixed support

words.enDefinition: A force a support or other constraint exerts on a body.

examples.en: A positive answer showed that the reaction force pointed in the direction we had drawn.
examples.zh: 结果为正，说明「约束反力」指向我们画出的方向。

examples.en: The tutor added the reaction force from the wall where the small block touched it.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在小滑块与墙面的接触处补画了墙施加的「约束反力」。

collocations: the direction of a reaction force

words.enDefinition: A moment exerted by a support that restrains rotation.

examples.en: We drew the reaction moment at the clamp as a curved arrow in the free-body diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在受力图中用弧形箭头表示夹具处的「支座反力矩」。

examples.en: The instructor asked whether the ideal hinge in the problem could exert a reaction moment.
examples.zh: 老师问，题中的理想铰链能否施加「支座反力矩」。

collocations: a reaction moment at a clamp

words.enDefinition: An idealized contact transmitting a normal force and no frictional force.

examples.en: The problem assumed smooth contact, so we drew a single force perpendicular to the surface.
examples.zh: 题目假定为「光滑接触」，因此我们只画了一个垂直于接触面的力。

examples.en: The tutor marked smooth contact where the small sphere touched the inclined plane in the drawing.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在图中标出小球与斜面接触处的「光滑接触」条件。

collocations: model smooth contact between two bodies

words.enDefinition: The contact force component directed perpendicular to a surface.

examples.en: We drew the normal reaction perpendicular to the sloped surface where it touched the block.
examples.zh: 我们在斜面与滑块的接触处画出垂直于斜面的「法向反力」。

examples.en: The normal reaction changed when the tutor added a downward pull to the practice sketch.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在练习图中加上一个向下的拉力后，「法向反力」发生了变化。

collocations: a normal reaction from a surface

words.enDefinition: The pulling force transmitted along a taut cable.

examples.en: We marked each cable tension along the line of its cable in the drawing of the ring.
examples.zh: 我们在圆环受力图上沿各自的缆索方向标出了「缆索拉力」。

examples.en: We found the cable tension by balancing its vertical component against the weight in the exercise.
examples.zh: 例题中，我们通过令竖直分量与重力平衡，求出了「缆索拉力」。

words.enDefinition: A member in equilibrium acted on by only two forces, which are equal, opposite, and collinear.

examples.en: We treated the light link as a two-force member because it had one force at each end.
examples.zh: 这根轻质连杆只在两端各受一个力，因此我们把它视为「二力杆」。

examples.en: The tutor showed why both forces on the two-force member had to act along the same line.
examples.zh: 辅导老师说明了为什么作用于「二力杆」的两个力必须沿同一条作用线。

collocations: model a link as a two-force member
the line of action of a two-force member

words.enDefinition: A load with constant intensity along its loaded length.

examples.en: We drew equally long arrows to represent a uniformly distributed load on the beam in our sketch.
examples.zh: 我们在梁的草图上画出等长的箭头，表示「均布载荷」。

examples.en: The equivalent force of our uniformly distributed load passed through the middle of the loaded segment.
examples.zh: 这段「均布载荷」的等效力经过受载段的中点。

collocations: replace a uniformly distributed load with its resultant
a uniformly distributed load on a beam

words.enDefinition: A distributed load whose intensity changes linearly with position.

examples.en: The arrows for the linearly varying load grew steadily longer from left to right in our sketch.
examples.zh: 在草图中，表示「线性变化载荷」的箭头从左向右均匀变长。

examples.en: We calculated the resultant of a linearly varying load by finding the area below its intensity line.
examples.zh: 我们求出强度线下方的面积，从而得到「线性变化载荷」的合力。

collocations: find the resultant of a linearly varying load

words.enDefinition: A load idealized as a force acting at one point.

examples.en: The textbook showed a point load as a single downward arrow at the middle of the beam.
examples.zh: 教材用梁中央单个向下的箭头表示「集中载荷」。

examples.en: We moved the point load closer to the left support and compared the reactions in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「集中载荷」移到离左支座更近的位置，并比较了反力。

collocations: represent a point load with an arrow

words.enDefinition: A load spread along a length or over an area.

examples.en: Our sketch showed a distributed load acting along just the right half of the model beam.
examples.zh: 草图显示，「分布载荷」只作用于模型梁的右半段。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to find the net force produced by the distributed load in the drawing.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们求图中「分布载荷」产生的合力。

collocations: find the resultant of a distributed load
a distributed load over part of the span

words.enDefinition: The amount of distributed force per unit length or area at a location.

examples.en: We labelled the load intensity in newtons per metre on the vertical axis of our plot.
examples.zh: 我们在图的纵轴上标注了「载荷强度」，单位是牛顿每米。

examples.en: The triangle showed zero load intensity at one end and its largest value at the other.
examples.zh: 三角形图示的一端「载荷强度」为零，另一端为最大值。

words.enDefinition: A concentrated force representing a parallel distributed load with the same net force and moment.

examples.en: We found the equivalent point load by using the area and centroid of the triangular loading diagram.
examples.zh: 我们利用三角形载荷图的面积及形心求出「等效集中载荷」。

examples.en: The equivalent point load gave the same support reactions in the example with the simple beam.
examples.zh: 在简支梁例题中，用「等效集中载荷」求得的支座反力相同。

collocations: replace a distributed load by an equivalent point load

words.enDefinition: A diagram indicating the positions, directions, and sizes of loads applied to a member.

examples.en: The loading diagram showed where the downward arrows began and ended along the small model beam.
examples.zh: 「载荷图」显示了小型梁模型上向下的箭头从哪里开始、到哪里结束。

examples.en: We used the loading diagram to check whether the second force was closer to the right support.
examples.zh: 我们用「载荷图」核对第二个力是否更靠近右支座。

collocations: read load values from a loading diagram

words.enDefinition: An imaginary cut exposing the internal forces and moments on a chosen section.

examples.en: We drew a section cut between the two point loads before sketching the exposed face.
examples.zh: 我们在两个集中载荷之间画出「假想截面」的位置，再勾画露出的断面。

examples.en: The tutor moved the section cut to a different location and asked us to redraw the internal arrows.
examples.zh: 辅导老师改变了「假想截面」的位置，让我们重画内力箭头。

collocations: a section cut through a beam

words.enDefinition: A force transmitted across a section between parts of the same body.

examples.en: The internal force appeared on our drawing only after we separated one part from the other.
examples.zh: 我们把物体分为两部分后，才在图上画出了「内力」。

examples.en: The tutor drew the internal force in opposite directions on the two faces of the cut.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在切口相对的两个面上画出方向相反的「内力」。

collocations: find an internal force at a cut
resolve an internal force into components

words.enDefinition: A force component along the longitudinal axis of a member.

examples.en: The axial force acted along the centerline of the simple bar in our solved example.
examples.zh: 在我们的已解例题中，「轴力」沿简单杆件的中心线作用。

examples.en: We marked the axial force as tensile because the arrows pulled away from the cut faces.
examples.zh: 由于箭头向外拉离截面，我们把「轴力」标为拉力。

words.enDefinition: An internal force component transverse to a member's longitudinal axis.

examples.en: We calculated the shear force just to the left of the downward load in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们计算了图中向下载荷紧邻左侧截面处的「剪力」。

examples.en: The tutor corrected the shear force arrow after checking the face shown by the section cut.
examples.zh: 辅导老师核对切口露出的是哪一面后，修正了「剪力」箭头的方向。

collocations: the shear force at a section

words.enDefinition: An internal moment tending to bend a member about an axis in its section.

examples.en: We found the bending moment at the cut by summing moments on the left segment.
examples.zh: 我们对左段的各力取矩并相加，求出截面处的「弯矩」。

examples.en: The tutor showed that the bending moment could change even where the beam cross-section stayed constant.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指出，即使梁的横截面不变，「弯矩」也可能随位置变化。

collocations: calculate a bending moment at a section

words.enDefinition: The moment component about a member's longitudinal axis, tending to twist it.

examples.en: The arrows in the sketch showed a torsional moment acting about the axis of the circular bar.
examples.zh: 草图的箭头表示一个绕圆杆轴线作用的「扭矩」。

examples.en: We marked the torsional moment on the exposed face after cutting the shaft in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在图中剖开轴，在露出的截面上标出了「扭矩」。

collocations: a torsional moment about the shaft axis

words.enDefinition: A force pulling on a body or drawing parts of a member apart.

examples.en: The tension force in the classroom drawing pulled the two ends of the member away from each other.
examples.zh: 在课堂图示中，「拉力」使杆件两端有相互远离的趋势。

examples.en: We marked the tension force on a rod that was pulled outward at both ends.
examples.zh: 这根杆件的两端都受到向外的牵拉，我们在图中标出了「拉力」。

collocations: calculate a tension force in a rod
a tension force along the axis

words.enDefinition: A force tending to compress a member by pushing toward its interior.

examples.en: The compressive force in our example pushed inward at the end of the model bar.
examples.zh: 例题中的「压缩力」从模型杆的端部向内推压。

examples.en: We showed the compressive force by pointing the two end arrows toward the center of the member.
examples.zh: 我们用两端指向杆件中心的箭头表示「压缩力」。

collocations: a compressive force along the axis

words.enDefinition: Friction that resists relative sliding between surfaces currently at rest with respect to each other.

examples.en: Static friction kept the classroom block from sliding down the small ramp in our demonstration.
examples.zh: 在课堂演示中，「静摩擦」使滑块没有沿小斜面滑下。

examples.en: We found that static friction matched the applied pull while the little box stayed still.
examples.zh: 我们发现，小盒保持静止时，「静摩擦」的大小与外加拉力相等。

collocations: a force due to static friction

words.enDefinition: The state just before sliding, with static friction at its limiting value.

examples.en: We discussed impending motion after increasing the pull until the block was just about to slide.
examples.zh: 增大拉力直到滑块恰好将要滑动后，我们讨论了「临界滑动」。

examples.en: The tutor used the impending motion assumption to set the static friction force at its limit.
examples.zh: 辅导老师根据「临界滑动」的假设，将静摩擦力取为其极限值。

words.enDefinition: The ratio of maximum static friction force to normal force for the contacting surfaces.

examples.en: The exercise gave the coefficient of static friction for the two surfaces in the sketch.
examples.zh: 题目给出了图中两个接触面之间的「静摩擦系数」。

examples.en: We multiplied the normal force by the coefficient of static friction to find the limiting friction force.
examples.zh: 我们将法向力乘以「静摩擦系数」，求得极限摩擦力。

collocations: measure the coefficient of static friction
estimate the coefficient of static friction
use the coefficient of static friction

words.enDefinition: The study of stresses, strains, and deformation in loaded bodies.

examples.en: Our mechanics of materials course began by measuring how a small sample stretched under a pull.
examples.zh: 「材料力学」课程一开始就测量一个小试样在拉力作用下如何伸长。

examples.en: The mechanics of materials exercise asked why two bars elongated differently under the same axial load.
examples.zh: 这道「材料力学」练习要求解释，为什么相同轴向载荷下两根杆伸长量不同。

words.enDefinition: A body whose shape or dimensions can change under loads.

examples.en: We treated the soft strip as a deformable body because its length changed visibly during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示中，软条的长度变化清晰可见，所以我们把它视为「变形体」。

examples.en: The instructor used a deformable body to illustrate the difference between moving and changing shape.
examples.zh: 老师用「变形体」说明了物体移动与形状改变的区别。

collocations: model an object as a deformable body

words.enDefinition: Loading applied along the longitudinal axis of a member.

examples.en: The classroom sketch showed axial loading with both arrows lined up along the straight bar's centerline.
examples.zh: 课堂草图显示的是「轴向加载」，两个力的箭头都与直杆中心线重合。

examples.en: We used an example of axial loading to compare the elongation of two bars in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用一个「轴向加载」的例题比较两根杆的伸长量。

words.enDefinition: The change in length of a member along its longitudinal axis.

examples.en: We calculated axial deformation by tracking the change in distance between two marks on the rod.
examples.zh: 我们记录杆上两个标记之间的距离变化，以计算「轴向变形」。

examples.en: The tutor plotted axial deformation against the applied load for the two textbook specimens.
examples.zh: 辅导老师绘图显示教材中两个试样的「轴向变形」如何随载荷变化。

words.enDefinition: Force per unit area acting perpendicular to the surface under consideration.

examples.en: The tutor drew the normal stress arrows perpendicular to the cut face of the model bar.
examples.zh: 辅导老师画出垂直于模型杆截面的「正应力」箭头。

examples.en: We found the average normal stress by dividing the axial force by the cross-sectional area.
examples.zh: 我们用轴力除以横截面积，得到了平均「正应力」。

collocations: the normal stress on a section

words.enDefinition: Normal stress that tends to pull material apart across a section.

examples.en: The cantilever developed tensile stress in its upper fibers near the clamp as its free end bent downward.
examples.zh: 悬臂模型的自由端向下弯曲时，靠近夹具的上部纤维承受「拉应力」。

examples.en: We shaded the part of the sample where tensile stress pulled the cut surfaces apart.
examples.zh: 我们用阴影标出试样中「拉应力」使截面两侧有分离趋势的部分。

collocations: apply tensile stress to a specimen

words.enDefinition: Normal stress that tends to press material together across a section.

examples.en: We marked compressive stress on one side of the neutral axis in the beam sketch.
examples.zh: 我们在梁草图中标出了中性轴一侧的「压应力」。

examples.en: A larger cross-sectional area gave a smaller average compressive stress for the same force in our example.
examples.zh: 在例题中，力的大小相同，横截面积越大，平均「压应力」越小。

words.enDefinition: The shear force on a surface divided by its area.

examples.en: We computed average shear stress using the total shear force and the area of the section.
examples.zh: 我们用总剪力和截面面积求出「平均剪应力」。

examples.en: The tutor compared average shear stress with the higher local value marked in the diagram.
examples.zh: 辅导老师将「平均剪应力」与图中标出的较高局部剪应力作了比较。

collocations: average shear stress across a section
compare average shear stress with local stress

words.enDefinition: Force per unit area acting tangentially to the surface under consideration.

examples.en: The small element illustrated shear stress with arrows parallel to each of the relevant faces.
examples.zh: 小单元图中用平行于各个相关面的箭头表示「剪应力」。

examples.en: We found that the shear stress in the circular shaft varied across its cross-section.
examples.zh: 我们发现，圆轴的「剪应力」在横截面上随位置变化。

words.enDefinition: A small material element used to show stress components acting on its faces.

examples.en: We drew a stress element at the marked location to show both normal and shear components.
examples.zh: 我们在标记位置画出「应力单元体」，显示正应力和剪应力分量。

examples.en: The tutor rotated the stress element and asked which components would act on its new faces.
examples.zh: 辅导老师转动「应力单元体」，问新的各个面上会有哪些应力分量。

collocations: label the faces of a stress element

words.enDefinition: The fractional change in length along a specified direction under the small-strain convention.

examples.en: We found the normal strain by comparing the change in length with the original length.
examples.zh: 我们用长度变化量与原长度的比值求出「正应变」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked for normal strain in the horizontal direction after the small square changed shape.
examples.zh: 习题要求计算小方形变形后沿水平方向的「正应变」。

collocations: normal strain in a given direction

words.enDefinition: In engineering usage, the angular change between material lines initially at right angles.

examples.en: We estimated shear strain from the change in angle between two originally perpendicular marked lines.
examples.zh: 我们根据原来互相垂直的两条标线之间的夹角变化估算了「剪应变」。

examples.en: The tutor sketched a tilted square to show what a positive shear strain meant in the example.
examples.zh: 辅导老师画了一个倾斜的方形，说明例题中正的「剪应变」表示什么。

words.enDefinition: The fractional length change along a member's longitudinal axis.

examples.en: The axial strain was negative because the distance between the two marks on the bar decreased.
examples.zh: 由于杆上两个标记之间的距离缩短了，「轴向应变」为负。

examples.en: We compared the axial strain in two samples whose original lengths were marked on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个试样的「轴向应变」，习题上已标明它们的原长度。

collocations: the average axial strain along a bar

words.enDefinition: The fractional dimensional change perpendicular to the direction of a uniaxial load.

examples.en: We recorded negative lateral strain when the sample became narrower during the classroom tension test.
examples.zh: 课堂拉伸试验中，试样变窄时，我们记录到负的「横向应变」。

examples.en: The tutor compared lateral strain across the width with axial strain along the length of the strip.
examples.zh: 辅导老师比较了软条宽度方向的「横向应变」和长度方向的轴向应变。

words.enDefinition: The increase in length of a specimen or member under load.

examples.en: The longer specimen showed more elongation under the same load in the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 课堂比较中，相同载荷作用下较长试样的「伸长量」更大。

examples.en: We recorded the elongation as the difference between the current and original distances between the marks.
examples.zh: 我们将两标记之间当前距离与原距离的差记为「伸长量」。

words.enDefinition: The applied axial force divided by the specimen's original cross-sectional area.

examples.en: We calculated engineering stress using the original cross-sectional area shown in the specimen sketch.
examples.zh: 我们用试样图中标出的原横截面积计算「工程应力」。

examples.en: The engineering stress curve began to fall even though the sample continued to stretch in the example.
examples.zh: 例题中，虽然试样继续伸长，「工程应力」曲线却开始下降。

words.enDefinition: The length change of a specimen divided by its original gauge length.

examples.en: We calculated engineering strain by dividing the measured extension by the specimen's original gauge length.
examples.zh: 我们把测得的伸长量除以试样的原始标距，算出了「工程应变」。

examples.en: The engineering strain values were small at the start of the classroom stretching demonstration.
examples.zh: 课堂拉伸演示刚开始时，各个「工程应变」数值都很小。

collocations: compare engineering strain with true strain

words.enDefinition: The axial force divided by the specimen's current cross-sectional area.

examples.en: We computed true stress using the area measured at the same instant as the load.
examples.zh: 我们用测量载荷那一刻测得的面积计算「真实应力」。

examples.en: The two stress estimates differed because true stress used the smaller area of the stretched sample.
examples.zh: 两种应力估计值不同，是因为「真实应力」使用试样拉伸后变小的面积。

collocations: compare true stress and engineering stress

words.enDefinition: The cumulative axial strain obtained by integrating length increments divided by their current lengths.

examples.en: We found the true strain by taking the natural logarithm of final length divided by original length.
examples.zh: 我们用当前长度除以原长度再取自然对数，求出了「真实应变」。

examples.en: The tutor compared true strain with engineering strain after the sample in the exercise stretched substantially.
examples.zh: 题中的试样大幅伸长后，辅导老师比较了「真实应变」和工程应变。

collocations: convert engineering strain to true strain

words.enDefinition: A plot showing how stress changes with strain during a test.

examples.en: We plotted a stress-strain curve after converting our classroom measurements of force and extension to stress and strain.
examples.zh: 我们将课堂测得的力和伸长量换算成应力和应变，再画出「应力–应变曲线」。

examples.en: The tutor marked the nearly straight part of the stress-strain curve before discussing why its slope mattered.
examples.zh: 辅导老师先标出「应力–应变曲线」上近似直线的一段，再讨论其斜率的意义。

collocations: the slope of a stress-strain curve

words.enDefinition: The range in which stress is proportional to strain and deformation is recoverable.

examples.en: The sample stayed in the linear elastic range, so its original length returned when we removed the load.
examples.zh: 试样处于「线弹性范围」内，因此卸载后恢复原长度。

examples.en: We fitted a straight line using only points from the linear elastic range of the plotted test data.
examples.zh: 拟合直线时，我们只使用了测试图中位于「线弹性范围」内的点。

collocations: stay within the linear elastic range
the slope in the linear elastic range
load within the linear elastic range

words.enDefinition: The greatest stress at which stress remains proportional to strain.

examples.en: The tutor marked the proportional limit where the stress-strain curve first departed from a straight line.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在应力–应变曲线刚开始偏离直线之处标出了「比例极限」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked whether the proportional limit could occur before the first permanent strain.
examples.zh: 习题问，在首次出现永久应变之前是否可能已达到「比例极限」。

collocations: the proportional limit on the curve

words.enDefinition: The greatest stress a material can sustain without residual deformation after unloading.

examples.en: The specimen exceeded its elastic limit, so it stayed slightly longer than its original length after the load was removed.
examples.zh: 例题中的试样超过了「弹性极限」，卸载后未恢复原有长度。

examples.en: We discussed why the elastic limit was difficult to locate using only the loading curve.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么仅凭加载曲线难以确定「弹性极限」。

words.enDefinition: The linear elastic relation equating axial stress to Young's modulus times axial strain.

examples.en: We applied uniaxial Hooke's law to relate the plotted stress to strain in the straight segment.
examples.zh: 我们用「单轴胡克定律」说明图中直线区段上应力与应变之间的关系。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether uniaxial Hooke's law still described the sample after it acquired permanent deformation.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，试样出现永久变形后，是否仍适用「单轴胡克定律」。

collocations: use uniaxial Hooke's law in tension

words.enDefinition: The linear elastic relation equating shear stress to shear modulus times shear strain.

examples.en: We used Hooke's law in shear to relate the shear stress to the angle change in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们用「剪切胡克定律」联系图中的剪应力与角度变化。

examples.en: The tutor asked what material property appeared in Hooke's law in shear for our small test element.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，对这个小试验单元应用「剪切胡克定律」时会用到什么材料参数。

words.enDefinition: The ratio of axial stress to axial strain in the linear elastic range.

examples.en: We found Young's modulus from the slope of the straight part of the stress-strain plot.
examples.zh: 我们用应力–应变图上直线段的斜率求出「杨氏模量」。

examples.en: A higher Young's modulus meant less axial strain under the same stress in our classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 课堂比较中，应力相同时，「杨氏模量」越高，轴向应变越小。

collocations: a material with a high Young's modulus

words.enDefinition: The ratio of shear stress to shear strain in the linear elastic range.

examples.en: The two samples had different shear modulus values even though their classroom drawings looked identical.
examples.zh: 两个试样的课堂示意图看起来相同，但它们的「剪切模量」不同。

examples.en: We identified the shear modulus as the slope of the initial linear segment in the shear test plot.
examples.zh: 我们把剪切试验图上初始直线段的斜率确定为「剪切模量」。

collocations: a material with a high shear modulus

words.enDefinition: The negative ratio of transverse strain to axial strain under uniaxial loading.

examples.en: We estimated Poisson's ratio by measuring both the width and length changes of the stretched strip.
examples.zh: 我们测量软条拉伸时的宽度和长度变化，以估算「泊松比」。

examples.en: The tutor explained why Poisson's ratio was positive for a sample that narrowed when stretched.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释了为什么试样拉伸时变窄，所得「泊松比」却为正。

words.enDefinition: A change in shape or dimensions that disappears when the load is removed.

examples.en: The small strip showed elastic deformation and returned to its original shape when we released it.
examples.zh: 小条发生了「弹性变形」，松开后便恢复了原形。

examples.en: We used a gentle pull to demonstrate elastic deformation on the model in the teaching lab.
examples.zh: 我们在教学实验室轻拉模型，演示了「弹性变形」。

words.enDefinition: A change in shape or dimensions that remains after the load is removed.

examples.en: The strip kept part of its new shape after unloading, which showed that plastic deformation had occurred.
examples.zh: 卸载后，小条仍部分保留了变形后的形状，说明发生了「塑性变形」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to changed dimensions after unloading as evidence of plastic deformation in the classroom specimen.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指出，课堂试样卸载后的尺寸变化说明产生了「塑性变形」。

words.enDefinition: The residual change in dimensions after a load has been removed.

examples.en: We measured the permanent set by comparing the sample's length before loading and after complete unloading.
examples.zh: 我们比较试样加载前与完全卸载后的长度，量出「永久变形量」。

examples.en: The ruler showed a small permanent set even though the sample recovered most of its displacement.
examples.zh: 尽管试样恢复了大部分位移，尺子仍显示有少量「永久变形量」。

words.enDefinition: A distinct point on a stress-strain curve where appreciable plastic deformation begins.

examples.en: The tutor marked the yield point where the strain began rising without much additional stress.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在应力几乎未再增加而应变开始明显增大处标出了「屈服点」。

examples.en: Our plots showed a clear yield point in one specimen but a gradual transition in the other.
examples.zh: 测试图显示，一个试样有明显的「屈服点」，另一个试样则逐渐过渡。

words.enDefinition: The stress where a line parallel to the elastic slope and shifted by a specified strain intersects the stress-strain curve.

examples.en: We found the offset yield strength by reading the intersection of the offset line and the curve.
examples.zh: 我们找到偏移直线与曲线的交点，由此读出「偏移法屈服强度」。

examples.en: The worksheet used offset yield strength because the sample's curve had no clearly marked yield point.
examples.zh: 由于试样曲线上没有明显的屈服点，习题采用了「偏移法屈服强度」。

words.enDefinition: The maximum engineering stress reached during a tensile test.

examples.en: The ultimate tensile strength was the highest point on the engineering stress curve in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 习题中，工程应力曲线的最高点对应「抗拉强度」。

examples.en: We located the ultimate tensile strength before checking where the sample actually separated on the curve.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「抗拉强度」，再确认曲线上试样实际断开的位置。

words.enDefinition: The strain at which a specimen fractures in a test.

examples.en: We marked the fracture strain at the end of the test curve where the specimen separated.
examples.zh: 试样断开处是测试曲线的终点，我们在那里标出了「断裂应变」。

examples.en: The tutor compared fracture strain values from specimens that broke at different amounts of extension.
examples.zh: 辅导老师比较了在不同伸长量下断开的试样各自的「断裂应变」。

words.enDefinition: The recoverable part of deformation that disappears during unloading.

examples.en: We observed elastic recovery when the loaded strip regained part of its length during unloading.
examples.zh: 卸载时，受载软条的长度有所恢复，我们由此观察到「弹性恢复」。

examples.en: The diagram showed elastic recovery as the horizontal change in strain along the unloading line.
examples.zh: 图中用卸载线上应变方向的水平变化量表示「弹性恢复」。

words.enDefinition: The product of Young's modulus and cross-sectional area for a member.

examples.en: Two bars had the same axial rigidity because they had identical cross-sections and the same material.
examples.zh: 两根杆的横截面相同，材料也相同，因此「抗拉压刚度」相同。

examples.en: We used axial rigidity together with length to predict how much the classroom rod would stretch.
examples.zh: 我们利用「抗拉压刚度」和长度，预测课堂杆件的伸长量。

collocations: the axial rigidity of a bar

words.enDefinition: A test that pulls a specimen while measuring its response to loading.

examples.en: The instructor displayed the force and extension recorded during a tensile test of the sample.
examples.zh: 老师展示了试样在「拉伸试验」中记录的拉力和伸长量。

examples.en: We used the tensile test data to compare how the two classroom specimens stretched before breaking.
examples.zh: 我们根据「拉伸试验」数据比较两个课堂试样在断裂前的伸长情况。

words.enDefinition: The distance between chosen reference marks used to measure a specimen's extension.

examples.en: We marked the gauge length between two lines before comparing the specimens in the teaching lab.
examples.zh: 在教学实验室比较试样之前，我们先标出两条线之间的「标距」。

examples.en: The worksheet gave the original gauge length so we could convert the measured extension to strain.
examples.zh: 习题给出了原始「标距」，让我们能把测得的伸长量换算成应变。

collocations: measure extension over the gauge length

words.enDefinition: A beam on two simple supports that allow end rotation and exert no reaction moment.

examples.en: We drew a simply supported beam with a pin on one side and a roller on the other.
examples.zh: 我们画了一根「简支梁」，一端是铰支座，另一端是滚动支座。

examples.en: The simply supported beam in our exercise carried a single downward load at the middle.
examples.zh: 练习中的「简支梁」在中央受到一个向下的集中载荷。

collocations: a point load on a simply supported beam
reactions of a simply supported beam

words.enDefinition: A beam fixed at one end and free at the other.

examples.en: The cantilever beam model was clamped at one end and visibly free to move at the other.
examples.zh: 这根「悬臂梁」模型一端被夹住，另一端显然是自由端。

examples.en: We drew the reaction moment at the fixed end of the cantilever beam in class.
examples.zh: 课上，我们在「悬臂梁」的固定端画出了反力矩。

collocations: the free end of a cantilever beam

words.enDefinition: A beam that extends beyond one or both of its outer supports.

examples.en: The overhanging beam in the sketch continued a short distance past the support on the right.
examples.zh: 草图中的「外伸梁」在右侧支座之外还延伸了很短一段。

examples.en: We compared an overhanging beam with a similar model that ended directly above its supports.
examples.zh: 我们将「外伸梁」与一个相似的模型比较，后者的两端恰好在支座正上方。

collocations: the support reactions of an overhanging beam
a load on an overhanging beam

words.enDefinition: The distance between the supports delimiting a length of beam.

examples.en: The diagram labelled the beam span between the two supports rather than the total length.
examples.zh: 图中标注的是两个支座间「梁的跨度」。

examples.en: We placed the point load halfway along the beam span in our first classroom example.
examples.zh: 在第一个课堂例题中，我们把集中载荷放在「跨度」的中点。

collocations: a load at the midpoint of the beam span

words.enDefinition: A load acting perpendicular to the longitudinal axis of a member.

examples.en: A transverse load bent the horizontal sample when the tutor pressed down near its center.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在水平试样的中心附近向下按压，「横向载荷」使试样弯曲。

examples.en: We marked the transverse load with an arrow perpendicular to the long axis of the strip.
examples.zh: 我们用垂直于软条长轴的箭头标出「横向载荷」。

collocations: a beam under a transverse load

words.enDefinition: Bending in a region with constant bending moment and zero transverse shear force.

examples.en: The middle of the model was in pure bending, with constant moment between the marked loads.
examples.zh: 模型中段处于「纯弯曲」状态，在标记的两个载荷之间弯矩恒定。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed zero shear force throughout the segment that was undergoing pure bending.
examples.zh: 习题显示，处于「纯弯曲」状态的那一段处处剪力为零。

words.enDefinition: A bending moment that curves a horizontal beam concave up with its lower fibers in tension.

examples.en: The tutor drew a sagging moment and shaded the lower fibers to show they were in tension.
examples.zh: 辅导老师画出「下挠弯矩」，并用阴影表示下部纤维受拉。

examples.en: In the sketch, the sagging moment made the small horizontal model curve upward like a bowl.
examples.zh: 草图中的「下挠弯矩」使小型水平模型弯成碗形，凹面朝上。

words.enDefinition: A bending moment that curves a horizontal beam concave down with its upper fibers in tension.

examples.en: The hogging moment put the upper fibers of the horizontal model into tension in our example.
examples.zh: 例题中，「上拱弯矩」使水平模型的上部纤维受拉。

examples.en: We drew the curved segment like an arch to illustrate the effect of the hogging moment.
examples.zh: 我们将这段曲线画成拱形，以说明「上拱弯矩」的作用。

collocations: a hogging moment at a support

words.enDefinition: A graph of internal shear force against position along a member.

examples.en: The shear force diagram had a jump at the position of the concentrated load in our exercise.
examples.zh: 例题的「剪力图」在集中载荷所在位置发生跳变。

examples.en: We read the shear force diagram just to the right of the support in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在「剪力图」上读取课堂模型支座紧邻右侧的剪力。

collocations: a jump in the shear force diagram

words.enDefinition: A graph of internal bending moment against position along a member.

examples.en: The bending moment diagram reached its highest value at the center of the symmetrically loaded beam.
examples.zh: 载荷对称的梁，其「弯矩图」在梁中心达到最高点。

examples.en: The tutor marked where the bending moment diagram crossed the horizontal axis in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 辅导老师标出了课堂例题中「弯矩图」与横轴的交点。

collocations: the peak of a bending moment diagram

words.enDefinition: The line in a bent beam cross-section along which longitudinal bending strain is zero.

examples.en: We drew the neutral axis through the center of the rectangular section in the pure bending example.
examples.zh: 在纯弯曲例题中，我们让「中性轴」穿过矩形截面的中心。

examples.en: The tutor marked the neutral axis where the longitudinal strain changed from tension to compression.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在纵向应变由拉应变变为压应变的位置标出了「中性轴」。

collocations: the distance from the neutral axis

words.enDefinition: The surface along a bent beam on which longitudinal bending strain is zero.

examples.en: The drawing showed the neutral surface extending along the beam between regions in tension and compression.
examples.zh: 图中，「中性层」沿梁的长度方向延伸，位于受拉区与受压区之间。

examples.en: We identified the neutral surface by tracing the neutral axis from one section to the next.
examples.zh: 我们沿各个截面追踪中性轴，确定了「中性层」。

collocations: the neutral surface of a bent beam

words.enDefinition: Longitudinal normal stress caused by bending a member.

examples.en: We plotted bending stress across the section and saw its sign change at the neutral axis.
examples.zh: 我们画出截面上的「弯曲应力」分布，发现其符号在中性轴处改变。

examples.en: The bending stress was largest in magnitude farthest from the neutral axis in our simple example.
examples.zh: 在这个简单例题中，离中性轴最远的地方「弯曲应力」的绝对值最大。

words.enDefinition: The product of Young's modulus and the second moment of area about the bending axis.

examples.en: The wider sample had greater flexural rigidity because its second moment of area was larger in the example.
examples.zh: 例题中，较宽试样的截面二次矩较大，因此「抗弯刚度」也较大。

examples.en: We held flexural rigidity constant while comparing the two loading diagrams in the beam exercise.
examples.zh: 在梁的练习中，我们保持「抗弯刚度」不变，比较两种载荷图。

collocations: a beam with greater flexural rigidity

words.enDefinition: The change in tangent direction per unit arc length along a bent beam.

examples.en: We compared beam curvature at two locations using the magnified shape of the deflected classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们把课堂模型变形后的形状放大，用来比较两处的「梁曲率」。

examples.en: The tutor explained why constant bending moment gave constant beam curvature in our uniform beam example.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释，在均匀梁例题中，为何弯矩恒定时「梁曲率」也恒定。

words.enDefinition: The transverse displacement of a beam from its unloaded position.

examples.en: We measured beam deflection at the center of the model with a scale beside it.
examples.zh: 我们用模型旁的刻度测量其中心处的「梁挠度」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to compare beam deflection before and after moving the cardboard model's small load.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们比较纸板模型上的小载荷移动前后的「梁挠度」。

words.enDefinition: A curve showing a beam's transverse displacement along its length.

examples.en: The deflection curve met the horizontal reference line at both supports in our simply supported example.
examples.zh: 在简支梁例题中，「挠曲线」在两个支座处都与水平基准线相交。

examples.en: We sketched a deflection curve after estimating which part of the model would move down most.
examples.zh: 我们估计模型哪一段下移最多，然后画出「挠曲线」。

collocations: the slope of a deflection curve

words.enDefinition: The slope of the tangent to the deflection curve at a specified position.

examples.en: The slope of a beam was zero at the point where the plotted deflection reached its smooth maximum.
examples.zh: 图中的挠度在平滑极大点处取最大值，该处的「梁挠曲线斜率」为零。

examples.en: We used the slope of a beam to compare the tangent directions near its two supports.
examples.zh: 我们用「梁挠曲线斜率」比较两个支座附近的切线方向。

collocations: calculate the slope of a beam
find the slope of a beam at a support
the maximum slope of a beam

words.enDefinition: The area of a slice taken perpendicular to an object's longitudinal axis.

examples.en: We found the cross-sectional area by multiplying the width and thickness of the rectangular sample.
examples.zh: 我们将矩形试样的宽度与厚度相乘，得到「横截面积」。

examples.en: The cross-sectional area of the circular specimen was given in square millimetres on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 习题以平方毫米给出了圆形试样的「横截面积」。

words.expression: product of inertia of an area
words.lemma: product of inertia of an area
words.enDefinition: The signed area integral of the product of the two Cartesian coordinates relative to a given pair of axes.
acceptedEnVariants: product of inertia of an area

examples.en: The product of inertia of an area vanished because the section was symmetric about the horizontal axis.
examples.zh: 由于截面关于水平轴对称，「面积惯性积」为零。

examples.en: We calculated the product of inertia of an area before finding the principal axes of the asymmetric section.
examples.zh: 我们先求「面积惯性积」，再确定不对称截面的主惯性轴。

collocations: calculate the product of inertia of an area
the product of inertia of an area about centroidal axes
a vanishing product of inertia of an area

words.enDefinition: The integral of signed distance from a chosen axis over an area.

examples.en: The first moment of area was zero because the two sides made equal contributions with opposite signs.
examples.zh: 两侧贡献大小相等、符号相反，因此「面积一次矩」为零。

examples.en: We used the first moment of area to locate the center of the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们用「面积一次矩」求出课堂图形的形心。

collocations: calculate the first moment of area
the first moment of area about an axis
a zero first moment of area

words.enDefinition: The integral of squared perpendicular distance from a chosen axis over an area.

examples.en: Turning the rectangle changed its second moment of area about the horizontal axis in our sketch.
examples.zh: 在草图中转动矩形之后，它对水平轴的「面积二次矩」发生了变化。

examples.en: The tutor used the second moment of area to compare two sections with the same total area.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「面积二次矩」比较两个总面积相同的截面。

collocations: calculate the second moment of area
the second moment of area about an axis
a larger second moment of area

words.enDefinition: The integral of squared radial distance from a chosen point over a plane area.

examples.en: We found the polar moment of area for a circle centered at the origin of our sketch.
examples.zh: 我们求出草图中以原点为圆心的圆的「极惯性矩」。

examples.en: The tutor related the polar moment of area to two perpendicular area moments about the same point.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释了「极惯性矩」与关于过同一点的两条垂直轴的面积二次矩之间的关系。

collocations: calculate the polar moment of area
the polar moment of area of a circle

words.enDefinition: The rule relating a second moment about a centroidal axis to one about a parallel axis.

examples.en: We applied the parallel-axis theorem to move from the centroidal axis to the bottom edge in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在习题中，我们用「平行轴定理」将计算所用的轴从形心轴移到底边。

examples.en: The tutor returned to the parallel-axis theorem after locating the centroids of the two rectangular parts.
examples.zh: 找出两个矩形部分的形心后，辅导老师又讲到了「平行轴定理」。

collocations: use the parallel-axis theorem for an area

words.expression: radius of gyration of an area
words.lemma: radius of gyration of an area
words.enDefinition: The square root of the ratio of the area's second moment about an axis to the area.
acceptedEnVariants: radius of gyration of an area

examples.en: We calculated the radius of gyration of an area using its tabulated area and second moment.
examples.zh: 我们根据表中的面积和面积二次矩算出「截面回转半径」。

examples.en: The radius of gyration of an area changed when the tutor selected a different axis in the drawing.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在图中另选一条轴后，「截面回转半径」发生了变化。

collocations: calculate the radius of gyration of an area
compare the radius of gyration of an area about two axes
the radius of gyration of an area about its centroidal axis

words.enDefinition: The second moment of area divided by the distance from the neutral axis to an extreme fiber.

examples.en: We used the section modulus to compare the extreme fiber stresses for two beams under the same moment.
examples.zh: 我们用「截面模量」比较两根梁在相同弯矩下边缘纤维的应力。

examples.en: The tutor showed that an asymmetric section could have a different section modulus on each side.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指出，不对称截面两侧的「截面模量」可能不同。

words.enDefinition: A cross-section analyzed as a combination of simpler shapes or materials.

examples.en: We divided the composite cross-section into three rectangles before finding its overall centroid in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在习题中，我们先将「组合截面」分成三个矩形，再求整体形心。

examples.en: The tutor drew each piece of the composite cross-section in a different color on the board.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在黑板上用不同颜色画出「组合截面」的各个部分。

collocations: the centroid of a composite cross-section
divide a composite cross-section into parts

words.enDefinition: Perpendicular axes through a point about which an area's product of inertia is zero.

examples.en: We found the principal axes of area by taking advantage of the rectangle's two symmetry lines.
examples.zh: 我们利用矩形的两条对称线确定了「截面主惯性轴」。

examples.en: The tutor rotated the coordinate lines until they matched the principal axes of area in the sketch.
examples.zh: 辅导老师旋转坐标轴，直到它们与草图中的「截面主惯性轴」重合。

collocations: find the principal axes of area
the orientation of the principal axes of area

words.enDefinition: The angular rotation of one cross-section relative to another under torsion.

examples.en: We measured the angle of twist between two marks on the ends of the classroom rod.
examples.zh: 我们测量课堂杆件两端标记之间的「扭转角」。

examples.en: The tutor compared the angle of twist for two circular rods shown in the same exercise.
examples.zh: 辅导老师比较了同一练习中两根圆杆的「扭转角」。

collocations: the angle of twist between two sections

words.enDefinition: The torsional moment needed to produce a unit angle of twist per unit length.

examples.en: The two rods had different torsional rigidity because their cross-sections differed in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂例题中，两根杆的横截面不同，所以它们的「抗扭刚度」不同。

examples.en: Our tutor used torsional rigidity to explain why the illustrated rods twisted by different amounts.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「抗扭刚度」解释图中各杆的扭转程度为什么不同。

collocations: the torsional rigidity of a circular shaft

words.enDefinition: Shear stress in a member produced by twisting.

examples.en: The torsional shear stress increased from the center to the outer edge of the circular section.
examples.zh: 从圆截面的中心到外缘，「扭转剪应力」逐渐增大。

examples.en: We drew the torsional shear stress on the cut face of the circular rod in class.
examples.zh: 课上，我们在圆杆的切面上画出了「扭转剪应力」。

collocations: torsional shear stress at the surface
